Plugin.name: SellVault
Plugin.Author: imaximum.tech
Plugin.Description: Unified market (shared MySQL with the Discord bot). Admins register storage barricades as sell boxes with /setsellbox; when a player closes a box, items in the market list are sold for Coins (price x (100% - commission), stock +amount) and other items are returned. Also handles Discord account linking + welcome pack + /coins.

Commands.Command: Register the open storage as a sell box (admin)
Link Discord with a code + get welcome pack
Reload market + sell boxes from DB
